text: RESULTS: Biopsy of the cervical lymph node reveals lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index are highly indicative of a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. speaker: Doctor
text: The normal bone marrow and PET-CT results suggest the disease is localized to the lymph node without systemic spread. speaker: Doctor
text: The normal immunohistochemistry for BCL2, BCL6, and MYC helps rule out common aggressive subtypes like follicular lymphoma or Burkitt lymphoma.
